purpose: Teach: 立たさ/公布/蜂起/死傷/迎撃/内包/輩出/わいせつ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が立たされる立場を警察、説明されてますね
lines.en: The suspect in this case is being informed of the charges against them by police, I take it?
lines.style: Thoughtful inquiry, almost conversational. Slight pause before the question, as if working through the logic aloud. Warm but observant—the tone of someone thinking alongside, not testing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、改正法の公布を市民に周知します
lines.en: The police will inform citizens about the revisions to the law and their publication.
lines.style: Even, professional delivery. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No rush. The measured tone of someone stating what will be done as a matter of procedure, not opinion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、暴動蜂起の動きを警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: So the police are also monitoring the situation for any signs of civil unrest in connection with this case?
lines.style: Careful, observant phrasing. A slight lean-in—genuine interest without skepticism. The voice of someone piecing together what's being done and why. Quiet respect for the scale of the work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、死傷事故の発生現場を保全します
lines.en: We'll secure and preserve the scene of any casualties or injuries that may occur.
lines.style: Stated with steady certainty. No hesitation—this is protocol spoken by someone who has said it before. Brief, complete, grounded. The tone of preparedness made clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、迎撃捜査の体制を警察、整えてらっしゃいますね
lines.en: The police have assembled quite a thorough investigative unit to handle this case, haven't they?
lines.style: Admiring undertone. Observant and a little warm—recognizing the scale and skill involved. Slight upswing at the end, inviting agreement. The respectful tone of noticing what someone has built.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪に内包される動機を解明します
lines.en: We're committed to uncovering the underlying motives behind the criminal conduct.
lines.style: Clear conviction without hardness. Measured pace. The tone of someone naming the real work—moving past the surface. Professional but not distant; this is what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地元から優秀な捜査官を輩出されてますね、警察
lines.en: This region has produced some exceptionally skilled investigators, and the police are drawing on that strength.
lines.style: Appreciative recognition. A note of quiet pride in the personnel. Conversational and warm, acknowledging local talent without overselling it. The tone of noticing capability.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、わいせつ事案には厳しく対応します
lines.en: The police take obscene conduct cases with the utmost seriousness and respond to them firmly.
lines.style: Shift to decisive firmness. Direct and unambiguous. The opening word carries slight weight. No softening—this is where the tone becomes clearer, more emphatic. Statement of principle.
